notes: TYC 2298-66-1 (T:p11-b8; I:p12-b2): candidates_found; its P_u is 50.3% only for the spectroscopic distance and 0.1% for the parallax distance, so the unbound status is distance-dependent. TYC 7111-718-1 (T:p13-b8; I:p12-b2): candidates_found as a hyper-runaway star; P_u=82.2% (parallax) and 70.7% (spectroscopic). TYC 8374-757-1 (T:p13-b9; I:p12-b2): candidates_found as a hyper-runaway candidate; P_u=50.4% (parallax), with large distance errors. TYC 3983-1873-1 (T:p13-b14; I:p12-b2): candidates_found only conditionally; P_u=97.2% with the spectroscopic distance but 1.5% with the parallax distance, and the paper calls it an HRS under the former and a BHVS under the latter. TYC 4032-1542-1 (T:p13-b15; I:p12-b2): candidates_found only conditionally; P_u=75.7% with the poorly constrained parallax distance but 0.0% with the spectroscopic distance. TYC 5890-971-1 (T:p13-b3; I:p16-b45): follow_up, not candidates_found; it was previously proposed as an escaping/HVS star, but this paper finally calls it a bound HVS (P_u=0.2%). HD 5223 (T:p14-b5): follow_up; Pereira et al. called it a hypervelocity star, whereas this paper finds it likely bound and not of GC origin; no Gaia identifier is supplied for it in Appendix A. TYC 2393-1001-1 (T:p13-b13; I:p12-b2): omitted; the sentence says '4 stars' but lists five, and this object has no Table 2 row or final unbound probability. TYC 8422-875-1 (T:p11-b9; I:p12-b2): omitted as a final unbound candidate because the authors finally call it a BHVS with P_u=29.1%.

TYC 2298-66-1: Table 2 notes (T:p12-b3) state that the quoted HRV errors do not include the 2.5 km/s uncertainty floor. Figure 7 (T:p11-b0) gives d0 = 1018 pc and v_GC = 225 km/s for a single Monte Carlo realization of TYC 2298-66-1 using the spectroscopic distance; these are not treated as independent summary measurements. The text (T:p11-b8) describes the same target as an HVS candidate with a >50% unbound probability and v ~ 530 km/s using the spectroscopic distance, consistent with the tabulated P^u_spec = 50.3% and v_GCspec = 519 km/s.

TYC 7111-718-1: The target TYC 7111-718-1 appears in Table 2 and in the Appendix A identifier table; it is not in Table 1, and no RA, declination, parallax, or proper-motion values for it are reported in the supplied text. There is a possible inconsistency in the quoted HRV uncertainty floor: T:p12-b3 says 2.5 km s^-1, while T:p5-b15 states that a 25 km s^-1 floor was adopted. I retained the Table 2 HRV value as printed.

TYC 8374-757-1: The target is TYC 8374-757-1 (HD 176387, MT Tel), listed among runaway star candidates in Table 2. Table 2 reports distance and Galactocentric velocity as medians with 16th/84th percentile uncertainties; I recorded the asymmetric errors accordingly. The table note says HRV errors do not include a 2.5 km/s uncertainty floor, while the text in §4.2.2 states a 25 km/s floor; this target's HRV error is retained exactly as tabulated. No RA, Dec, parallax, proper motions, or galactocentric radius are reported for this star in the supplied material. The pc distance is the Table 2 estimate; the separate distance modulus is the additional PLZ-based estimate quoted in §7.2. The text describes the median total velocity approximately as ∼530 km s−1 and notes large distance errors; Table 2 provides the tabulated median and asymmetric percentiles. Only the unbound probability P^u is reported; no separate bound probability is tabulated.

TYC 3983-1873-1: TYC 3983-1873-1 appears in Table 1 and in Table 2 under "Uncertain candidates"; the paper reports two distance-dependent sets, one using the parallax-inferred distance with the Milky Way prior and one using the spectroscopic distance, and both are retained. Table 2 notes that distances and Galactocentric velocities are medians with 16th/84th percentile errors (T:p12-b3), and that HRV errors exclude the adopted 2.5 km/s floor (T:p12-b3). Section 7.3 says there are "4 stars with uncertain interpretation" but then lists five, including this target (T:p13-b13); Table 2 nevertheless includes it in the uncertain group. No explicit numeric galactocentric radius for this star is tabulated; Figure 6 only plots it, so galactocentric_radius is not extracted.

TYC 4032-1542-1: Table 2 (T:p12-b2) classifies TYC 4032-1542-1 among the "Uncertain candidates"; its velocity and unbound probability depend strongly on the adopted distance, so the parallax-inferred and spectroscopic results are both retained. The HRV error note in T:p12-b3 states that the 2.5 km/s uncertainty floor is not included in the quoted HRV errors. No explicit galactocentric radius is tabulated for this star.

TYC 5890-971-1: The supplied material does not report equatorial coordinates, parallax, or proper-motion components for TYC 5890-971-1; it appears in Table 2 and Appendix A. The ∼360 km/s value is included as a previous-study total-velocity estimate with the caveat that the paper does not explicitly label that sentence as Galactic rest frame. Table 2 notes say a 2.5 km/s uncertainty floor is not included in quoted HRV errors, while §4.2.2 states 25 km/s; the quoted HRV error is retained as reported.

TYC 1739-1500-1: For HD 5223 (TYC 1739-1500-1), the paper does not explicitly restate the reference frame of its velocity determination of 288 km/s in this passage; the context compares it directly with Pereira et al.'s total Galactic-frame velocity, so it is recorded as a Galactic rest-frame velocity. No bound or unbound probability is reported for this star. Relevant passage: T:p14-b5.
